newsitem.title: USA: MSB Financial to buy back 5 pct of shares.
newsitem.headline: MSB Financial to buy back 5 pct of shares.

text.p: MSB Financial Inc said Monday it intends to repurchase up to five percent of its outstanding shares in the open market over the 12 months.

The thrift holding company said it will purchase the shares at prevailing market rates from time to time depending on market conditions. The buyback program has received approval from the Office of Thrift Supervision, MSB said.
"We believe that the repurchase of our shares represents an attractive investment opportunity which will benefit the company and our shareholders," MSB president Charles Cook said in a statement.
The repurchased shares will become treasury shares and be used for general corporate purposes.

Under previously completed programs, MSB said it has repurchased 98,871 common shares, or 13 percent of its shares outstanding. As of December 31, 1996, the company, which owns Marshall Savings Bank FSB, had 642,636 shares of common stock outstanding and had total assets of $66.5 million.
